name: Ghoul Rib
summary: In Duskwood, ghouls roam the groves and cemeteries, and Abercrombie asks for their ribs. The hermit says he needs them to build an effigy that will ward off the flesh-eating horrors near his shack.

sections.title: A Gruesome Ward
sections.body: Ghouls haunt Duskwood, among them Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones, and Plague Spreaders. Abercrombie lives alone in a shack north of Raven Hill Cemetery and asks travelers for their sturdy, rotted ribs. He says he lives beyond the Night Watch’s protection in Darkshire and needs a fearsome effigy to frighten the dead away from his home.

sections.title: Suspicions Around the Shack
sections.body: Abercrombie’s request for ghoul parts draws questions. He could seek shelter behind Darkshire’s palisades or use consecrated wards, yet he insists on collecting raw necromantic remains to protect his secluded shack.

faq.answer: Ghoul Ribs come from several kinds of ghouls in Duskwood, including Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones, and Plague Spreaders. They haunt old graveyards, roadside ruins, and abandoned homesteads across the forest.

faq.q: Why does Abercrombie want these bones?
aliases: what does abercrombie do with ribs
faq.answer: Abercrombie says his home is too far from Darkshire for the Night Watch to protect him. He asks for ribs to build a crude scarecrow or effigy that he believes will keep roving undead from his walls.

faq.q: Do scarecrows actually keep ghouls away?
faq.answer: Ghouls are driven by hunger or dark necromantic force, and generally feel no fear. Abercrombie still insists that a scarecrow made of bones will keep his home safe.

aliases: where to turn in ghoul ribs
faq.answer: Abercrombie’s shack stands in western Duskwood, just north of Raven Hill Cemetery.

angles.text: Handling the desecrated bones of the restless dead is grim work. Helping an isolated hermit face ravenous horrors fits a paladin’s duty to guard the living in Duskwood.
The twisted force that reanimates these bones shows the deep shadow over Duskwood, where fallen villagers become ravenous scavengers.
